name: typecheck-watch
description: TypeScript errors as they appear. Streams one line per diagnostic.

name: test-watch
description: Vitest failures in real time. Streams failing test names and assertion errors.

name: playwright-trace
description: Playwright failures in real time. Streams failing locator and timeout errors. Lazy-armed when the vitest-rtl-playwright skill activates.

name: bundle-watch
description: Bundle regressions: chunk size growth >10KB or forbidden Clerk imports. Lazy-armed when tanstack-query skill activates.
